mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right end of the horizontal axis passing through a circle). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right arrow of the horizontal axis beside the two branches).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right end of the horizontal axis passing through a circle on the left and the right arrow of the horizontal axis beside the two branches on the right.
